benchmarks-2026-10-25.scope: HTTP AR, DFlash2 and MTP single-user depth grids and C1/2/4/6/8 concurrency tables, loading and memory for all three targets.

gufoConsistency.singleUserSpeculativeMatchingAr: 48 of 48 (3 targets x 2 modes x 8 depths, mixed text)
gufoConsistency.multiUserMatchingIsolatedAr: every request in multi-ar, multi-dflash2 and multi-mtp, all targets
gufoConsistency.metric: SHA-256 of completion text; does not establish original-checkpoint accuracy.

remeasured: multi-ar-q4: the sweep's C8 cell (148.93 tok/s) was an outlier; two alternating reruns of b43f7b4d and 7b1e23a8 gave 165.49-166.22, and the table uses the first 7b1e23a8 rerun.
single-ar-q4: the sweep's 32K and 64K prefill cells (1,806 / 1,304 tok/s) were low; an A/B rerun gave 1,911 / 1,378 on b43f7b4d and 1,923 / 1,389 on 7b1e23a8, and the table uses that 7b1e23a8 rerun.
